project: Virtual Bee Swarm (Immerse the Bay 2026) - temp stylized art set

conventions.transforms: no rotation or scale on any node (all applied)
conventions.formats: GLB (glTF 2.0) + FBX 7.4 (UnitScaleFactor 100, Y-up; import with Convert Units on) + .blend
conventions.materials: VBS_Palette (emission 0.08), VBS_Palette_Bee (emission 0.45, bees/wasps/hornet/Beeswax, reads in passthrough), VBS_Glow (emission 1.0: embers, flame, lit hex), VBS_GlowSoft (alpha 0.35 halo), VBS_PaneLive / VBS_PaneFallback (portal panes, real UVs)
conventions.colour: Every face has BOTH a UV at the center of one 8x8-cell 64 px palette texture (_shared/VBS_Palette.png, use Point filtering, no mips needed) AND an sRGB vertex colour (FBX only, for the Honeymoon/Unlit shader). GLB has no COLOR_0 on purpose: glTF multiplies it with the texture.
conventions.palette: amber #F2A900, honey #FFC845, cream #FFF3D6, charcoal #2B2B2B, leaf #5BAA4A, sky #7EC8E3, fire #FF6B2C (+ helpers; full list in _source/scripts/common.py PALETTE)
conventions.rebuild: blender -b --factory-startup --python _source/scripts/build_all.py -- --out OUT_DIR (about 20 s for all 20); contact sheet: _source/tools/contact_sheet.py
conventions.art_director_changes: smoker (steel/copper, pleated red leather bellows), giant_hornet (pincer mandibles, scaled 0.8 to ~0.26 m), moon (readable craters), worker_bee (eyes spread apart), 5 palette colours appended (steel_mid, copper, leather, leather_dark, moon_light)

summary.third_party_files: Kenney Particle Pack sprites (CC0) in smoker/vfx_kenney_cc0 and ember/vfx_kenney_cc0 only

beeswax.license: original, generated for this project (procedural Blender script; no attribution needed)

bounds_m.unity_space: meters, X right, Y up, Z = front (glTFast / Unity FBX import)

beeswax.animate: Body (empty): BeeswaxController scales it while talking. Mouth: pivot on its top edge, scale local Y to open (Y=0 closed). WingL / WingR: pivot at the wing root, rotate on Unity Z to flap. Empties: HandR (holds the Clipboard), HandL, CaptionAnchor.
beeswax.notes: No skeleton; everything animates by transforms, like the placeholder. Names match BuildHoneymoonScene.cs (Mouth, WingL, WingR). For BeeswaxController.dustyRenderers assign the Torso and Head renderers (as the placeholder does). Clipboard is a separate child mesh (hide/swap freely). ~0.38 m tall incl. antennae. Bee material is slightly emissive for passthrough.

hive.license: original, generated for this project (procedural Blender script; no attribution needed)

bounds_m.unity_space: meters, X right, Y up, Z = front (glTFast / Unity FBX import)

hive.animate: LiftRoot: rotate/raise to tip or heft the hive (everything below hangs off it). Lid: pivot on the back-bottom edge, rotate on X to open or move up to lift. Door: pivot at the entrance, scale.x = entrance width (HiveBody 'Door widths (scale.x)'). EntranceReducer: separate wooden cleat resting on the landing board, pivot at its base: slide it into the slot at station 3. HeatGlow: soft glow box, disabled by default, enable for the heat wave. HexSlot1-4 (under Hexagons): parent hexagon_tile instances here. DoorPoint, SwarmCenter: empties kept from the placeholder.
hive.notes: Entrance faces +Z. The placeholder scene's door faces -Z, so if the slot loader keeps the placeholder's orientation, rotate the prefab 180 deg on Y. BoxUpper is open on top with frames + comb inside (visible when the Lid lifts). 'LOCAL 20,000' plaque on the brood box (small text).

bounds_m.unity_space: meters, X right, Y up, Z = front (glTFast / Unity FBX import)

hexagon_tile.animate: Two states side by side: HexTile (cream Face = not done) and HexTile_Lit (glowing Face_Lit with the Glow material = done). Toggle between them, or swap the Face material, when a station is solved.
hexagon_tile.notes: Pointy-top, 4.4 cm across, faces +Z, pivot = center of the back face. Fits HexSlot1-4 on the hive. Each state is its own root object with its own pivot, 3 cm left/right of the file origin: zero its position when you make the prefab.
